query: WITH listing AS ( SELECT DISTINCT series_id, replace(provider_title_normalized, ' ', '') AS key FROM series_sources WHERE provider_title_normalized <> '' ), over_shared AS ( SELECT key FROM ( SELECT replace(normalized_title, ' ', '') AS key, id AS series_id FROM series WHERE normalized_title <> '' UNION SELECT replace(normalized, ' ', '') AS key, series_id FROM series_titles WHERE normalized <> '' UNION SELECT key, series_id FROM listing ) k GROUP BY key HAVING count(*) > $2 ), by_canonical AS ( SELECT a.id AS lo, b.id AS hi FROM series a JOIN series b ON replace(a.normalized_title, ' ', '') = replace(b.normalized_title, ' ', '') AND a.id < b.id WHERE a.normalized_title <> '' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM over_shared o WHERE o.key = replace(a.normalized_title, ' ', '')) ), by_alias AS ( SELECT LEAST(s.id, st.series_id) AS lo, GREATEST(s.id, st.series_id) AS hi FROM series s JOIN series_titles st ON replace(st.normalized, ' ', '') = replace(s.normalized_title, ' ', '') WHERE st.series_id <> s.id AND s.normalized_title <> '' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM over_shared o WHERE o.key = replace(s.normalized_title, ' ', '')) ), by_shared_alias AS ( SELECT x.series_id AS lo, y.series_id AS hi FROM series_titles x JOIN series_titles y ON replace(x.normalized, ' ', '') = replace(y.normalized, ' ', '') AND x.series_id < y.series_id WHERE x.normalized <> '' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM over_shared o WHERE o.key = replace(x.normalized, ' ', '')) ), by_listing AS ( SELECT LEAST(l.series_id, o.series_id) AS lo, GREATEST(l.series_id, o.series_id) AS hi FROM listing l JOIN ( SELECT id AS series_id, replace(normalized_title, ' ', '') AS key FROM series WHERE normalized_title <> '' UNION ALL SELECT series_id, key FROM listing ) o ON o.key = l.key AND o.series_id <> l.series_id WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM over_shared x WHERE x.key = l.key) ), pairs AS ( SELECT lo, hi FROM by_canonical UNION SELECT lo, hi FROM by_alias UNION SELECT lo, hi FROM by_shared_alias UNION SELECT lo, hi FROM by_listing ) SELECT p.lo AS "lo!", p.hi AS "hi!" FROM pairs p WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM merge_candidates mc WHERE mc.series_id = p.lo AND mc.candidate_id = p.hi ) LIMIT $1
